title: Group and longitudinal intra-individual networks of eating disorder symptoms in adolescents and young adults at-risk for an eating disorder
sample_size: 1272 participants for group-level networks; 50 participants for individual networks
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subject network
limitations: - Random selection of 50 individuals for individual networks; - Data collected retrospectively with potential recall bias; - Time lag of four weeks may not capture shorter-term dynamics; - Cannot make causal claims due to non-experimental design; - Models with only three nodes due to symptom endorsement heterogeneity; - Limited generalizability to other eating disorders without BMI or broader symptom coverage.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. The code and data are declared available in the supplementary materials, but the specific repository or link is not provided in the text. The individual networks were computed on a subset of 50 participants, which may limit generalizability.
